source_title: Anirudh enjoys Dhol celebration at home ahead of wedding with Kavya Maran
source_excerpt: Wedding celebrations have begun at music composer Anirudh Ravichander's home, with his family and close friends joining the fun ahead of his marriage to Kavya Maran. A video from the celebration shows Anirudh enjoying a lively Dhol performance. The composer was spotted sitting on the traditional musical instrument and having fun as the musicians played around him. The joyous occasion has attracted the attention of many fans who are waiting to hear more about the couple's wedding. The occasion is a sneak peek into the joyful times that are happening at the house of Anirudh before the big day.Anirudh and Kavya Maran wedding date and reception plansThese festivities precede the wedding of Anirudh and Kavya Maran, scheduled to take place on November 11, 2026, with a subsequent big reception planned on November 21 in Chennai. Kavya is the daughter of the Chairman of Sun Group, Kalanithi Maran, and the CEO of Sunrisers Hyderabad. The wedding will reportedly be a very private one, where only close family and friends are going to attend the event. But the Chennai reception will reportedly witness many popular faces from the world of films and politics.Anirudh-Kavya Maran wedding preparations and celebrity invitationsThe wedding has also drawn attention due to the celebrity guests who are likely to be part of the celebration ceremony. Kalanithi Maran and his wife Kavery have been said to invite many important personalities personally. The personal invitations made by the couple include Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay and Prime Minister Narendra Modi, among others. News about the invitations has also created some interest in the same. The wedding of the couple has become a hot topic, and it is especially true for Anirudh's fans.Anirudh Ravichander's personal life and new chapter with Kavya MaranAnirudh keeps his personal life private and rarely talks about his relationships. His association with Kavya Maran came into the spotlight after reports and pictures of the two spending time together overseas surfaced online. Since then, their reported relationship has attracted considerable attention. Now, as the wedding celebrations begin at his home, the composer appears to be enjoying the special moments with his loved ones. While the Dhol celebration has offered fans a small glimpse of the festivities, the upcoming Chennai reception is expected to be one of the major social events of the season.The Chennai reception is expected to see several prominent personalities from the film industry and politics. Prime Minister Narendra Modi and Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay are among the names reportedly invited to the celebrations.
